topic: Discussing OOH measurement limitations and client reporting
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered technical limitations in Out-of-Home (OOH) measurement and best practices for client reporting.

*   **Measurement Challenges:** Concerns were raised regarding the ability of Wi-Fi sensors to accurately capture in-vehicle audiences, which account for a significant portion of roadside OOH impacts. The intermittent nature of Wi-Fi probes makes accurate counting difficult when people are moving quickly in vehicles.

decisions: The team will prepare for client questions regarding the measurement of in-vehicle audiences.
The team must be prepared to explain the complexities of calculating transparent reach and frequency due to MAC address rotation.
action_items: Someone needs to share a presentation example showing how clients display data to media agencies/brands (following discussion with Adboard client).
